$comment: Scoped npm-audit allowlist consumed by scripts/ship.mjs (the /ship gate). Each entry is a High+ advisory with NO non-breaking upstream fix, triaged as not reachable in this template. RULE: every id here MUST have a matching row in SECURITY.md §13 (tracked CVE remediations) and §12 (suppression log). Re-audit on every dependency bump; delete the entry the moment a fix ships or reachability changes. A High+ advisory NOT listed here still fails /ship.

advisories.reason: Quadratic-complexity DoS in nodemailer's addressparser. **A fixed release DOES exist** — 10.0.6+ (latest 10.0.13) — but the installed line is 9.x and 10.x is a MAJOR bump of a direct runtime dependency, so there is no NON-BREAKING upstream fix, which is what this file allows. Deferred rather than taken because the bump needs its own verification pass (lib/email.ts uses createTransport/sendMail only, and next-auth declares nodemailer as an OPTIONAL peer at ^7||^8 that the existing ^9 override already exceeds — so it looks low-risk, but 'looks' is not a check). Not reachable meanwhile: lib/auth.ts registers only the Credentials and Microsoft Entra providers (no Auth.js email provider), nodemailer has exactly one call site, and sendEmail() returns {sent:false} WITHOUT calling sendMail while SMTP_HOST is unset — production's current state. When SMTP is configured the addresses come from HR-imported employee records, not anonymous request input. (O(n^2) via a crafted address LIST.) RE-AUDIT TRIGGERS: SMTP_HOST being set, OR the 10.x bump landing. SECURITY.md 12/13.
